audit_name: Audit 1: Order Reservation TTL Expiration & Fencing

findings.title: TTL Parameter Coupling Defect in reserve_order_slot
findings.description: reserve_order_slot() evaluates existing reservation age against incoming caller's ttl_seconds parameter instead of the active reservation's own TTL duration. Furthermore, ttl_seconds is not stored in _pending_reservation.
findings.impact: If Worker A reserves for 0.1s, Worker B requesting 30s is blocked for 30s rather than acquiring the slot after 0.1s. Conversely, if Worker A reserved for 60s, Worker B with 5s TTL clears Worker A's reservation prematurely after 5 seconds.

findings.title: Uncontended Expired Reservation Commit Defect
findings.description: commit_order_reservation() validates only token equality ('self._pending_reservation.get("token") == token') without checking whether the reservation's TTL has expired. If no competing worker requests a reservation in the meantime, a delayed or hung worker can commit an expired lease.
findings.impact: Delayed/stale order executions that suffered extreme network or garbage-collection pauses (>30s) are committed into positions and ledger after their intended market window closed.

findings.title: Unchecked Pre-Commit Mutation in open_simulated_trade
findings.description: In open_simulated_trade(), line 512 sets 'self.open_position = pos' BEFORE calling self.commit_order_reservation(res_token, pos) at line 513, and completely ignores the boolean return value of commit_order_reservation. If commit fails (e.g. token preempted or invalid), self.open_position remains assigned and is persisted to disk at line 514.
findings.impact: Violates the fundamental purpose of reservation fencing: even if a worker is fenced off and its reservation rejected on commit, the position is already accepted and committed to disk anyway.
findings.test_proof: Code inspection and architectural invariant review

test_scenarios.scenario: Normal reservation and commit within TTL
Expired reservation preemption by competing worker
Uncontended expired lease commit defect demonstration
